title: Look Where the Grasp Fails: Calibration-Aware Active Viewpoint Selection over a Multimodal 6D Pose Belief
description: Pre-registered simulation study (MuJoCo, Franka Panda) of active camera viewpoint selection for grasping. A task-risk view objective that treats calibration as exact does not help; modelling view-dependent extrinsic calibration bias (D2) beats entropy and covariance objectives, and online self-calibration adds a further gain. Final study (299 paired episodes): full system 0.773 vs Kalman-tracking baseline 0.488 grasp success. Simulation only. Code, experiment registry and all results: https://github.com/parammadan/belief-3d
